cli-updater.reason: CLI update checks are explicit maintenance operations.

code-review-fix.reason: Claude-only fix loop should be explicitly invoked.

commit.reason: Git commit and push operations require explicit user intent.

consistency-audit.reason: Cross-artifact consistency audits run through the consistency-auditor agent as advisory-only evidence; avoid wrapping it in a generic nested subagent.

deep-research.reason: Deep research is expensive and intentionally manual.

delivery-estimator.reason: 需求排期、交付窗口、投入时长和风险承诺需要用户显式触发。

delivery-owner.reason: Delivery owner orchestration starts after explicit handoff.

design.reason: Architecture design requires confirmed upstream inputs.

developer.reason: Developer task execution runs through the managed developer agent after an explicit task contract.

doc-review-fix.reason: Claude-only document review loop should be explicitly invoked.

feishu-docs.reason: Feishu document mutation requires explicit user intent.

fix.reason: Root-cause fix mode runs through the managed fixer agent from explicit failure evidence.

github-repo-radar.reason: GitHub repository radar is a specialized research workflow and must be explicitly invoked.

overview.reason: Project overview writes artifacts and requires confirmation, so it should be explicitly invoked.

product-director.reason: Product director work starts an explicit standard-chain phase.

product-manager.reason: Product manager work requires frozen director inputs.

qft-group-chat-export.reason: 全房通客服机器人群对话导出会读取内部数据库并写入分析文件，必须由用户显式触发。

qft-branch-flow.reason: 全房通 Git 分支流程会影响仓库状态和推送边界，必须由用户显式触发。

project-memory.reason: Project memory initialization/audit should be explicit.

prompt.reason: Prompt engineering and system-prompt design are specialized and can misroute normal implementation tasks; require explicit invocation.

qa.reason: QA ownership runs through the managed qa agent with an explicit submitted build or task.

refactor.reason: Refactor work changes structure and should be explicitly invoked.

research.reason: Research workflows are broad and potentially high-cost, so they should be explicitly invoked.
research.routing_boundary: Use for evidence-backed research, option discovery, technical/product investigation, and solution comparison outside installable agent skill discovery.

review.reason: Structured standard-chain review is a manual first-party skill; ordinary Codex code review should use the official /review or codex review entrypoint.

rules-manager.reason: Project rules mutation should be explicit.

scan.reason: Whole-repository health scans are high-cost orchestrator workflows and own their internal parallel agent dispatch.

security.reason: Security reviews are high-impact scans and should be explicitly invoked.

skill-quality-audit.reason: Skill quality audits are high-cost orchestrator workflows and own their internal subagent/eval dispatch.

tech-lead.reason: Task planning requires confirmed product/design/test inputs.

test-design.reason: Test obligation design requires confirmed requirements and architecture.

ux.reason: UX walkthroughs and state matrices should be explicit.

verify.reason: Task-level AC verification runs through the managed verifier agent from explicit task context.

worktree.reason: Worktree creation changes git state and should be explicit.
